a kid of Ravina's saw groats through a skylight and fell from the roof to the ground; they brought it before Rav Ashi

a ewe at Rav Chaviva's house whose hind legs dragged

rheumatism is common; a severed spinal cord is not common

even though they are in pain and stand still -- it is mere fever that has seized them
if they fell to the ground -- we are certainly concerned

what is the reason? when they throw them they throw them onto their hips, so that they will run before them
[if the thieves] returned them -- we are certainly concerned
and this is only where they returned them out of fear
but out of repentance -- they have done a proper repentance [and there is no concern]
struck it on the head and [the stick] ran toward the tail, or on the tail toward the head, along the whole spine -- no concern for shattered limbs
and if the stick ended at the middle of the back -- we are concerned
and if it [the stick] has knots -- we are concerned
and if he struck it crosswise -- we are concerned
Rav Nachman: the womb carries no [concern] of shattered limbs
the baraita: a one-day-old infant becomes impure by a zav-discharge

the baraita: and all agree that if it [a firstborn] was born with its blemish, it is of what is prepared [for Yom Tov]
R' Yochanan: R' Shimon conceded with regard to sacrificial animals that [one born by caesarean] is not holy
Rav Nachman: the slaughterhouse carries no [concern] of shattered limbs
a bull fell and the sound of its groan was heard; Rav Yitzchak bar Shmuel bar Marta went in and took of the choicest cuts
the Rabbis to him: from where do you have this?
thus said Rav: it digs in its claws until it reaches the ground
[a fallen animal that] stood -- does not need [a wait of] twenty-four hours
[but] inspection it certainly needs
[if it] walked -- it does not need inspection
Rav Chiyya bar Ashi: both this and that need inspection
Rav (via Rav Yirmeya bar Acha): [if] it stretched out its foreleg to stand, even though it did not stand [-- it counts as having stood]
[if] it lifted its leg to walk, even though it did not walk [-- it counts as having walked]
Rav Chisda: [if] it struggled to stand, even though it did not stand [-- it counts as having stood]
the ruling: where it fell from the roof unawares [-- stood and did not walk: inspection, not twenty-four hours; walked: not even inspection]
the fallen animal they spoke of needs inspection against the intestines
it needs inspection against the whole body cavity
Huna Mar to Rav Ashi: the simanim -- what [of them]?

Shmuel (via Rav Yehuda): a bird that was struck on the surface of the water -- once it swam its full length, it is enough
we said this only [where it swam] from below to above
but from above to below -- it is the water that carried it down
and if the water is standing -- we have no concern with it
and if one threw chips and it overtook them -- it has overtaken them [and there is no concern]
a stretched cloak -- we are concerned
not stretched -- we are not concerned
[a cloak] folded over and over -- we are not concerned
a net whose knots are close -- we are concerned
its knots not close -- we are not concerned
flax made into bundles -- we are concerned
on this side or that side [of the bundles] -- we are not concerned
bundles of reeds -- we are concerned
flax beaten and combed -- we are not concerned
beaten and not combed -- we are concerned
made into skeins -- since it has knots, we are concerned

fine tow -- we are not concerned
navra [palm fibre] -- we are concerned
timachta [palm bark] -- we are not concerned

unsifted -- we are not concerned

coarse sand -- we are concerned
road dust -- we are concerned

not made into a bundle -- we are not concerned

nodes.label_he: ההוא תורא דנפל ואישתמע קל גניחותיה, על רב יצחק בר שמואל בר מרתא שקל משופרי שופרי
nodes.label_en: a bull fell and the sound of its groan was heard; Rav Yitzchak bar Shmuel bar Marta went in and too…

nodes.label_he: מנא לך הא?
nodes.label_en: the Rabbis to him: from where do you have this?

nodes.label_he: הכי אמר רב: צפרניו נועץ עד שמגיע לארץ
nodes.label_en: thus said Rav: it digs in its claws until it reaches the ground

nodes.label_he: עמדה -- אינה צריכה מעת לעת
nodes.label_en: [a fallen animal that] stood -- does not need [a wait of] twenty-four hours

nodes.label_he: בדיקה -- ודאי בעיא
nodes.label_en: [but] inspection it certainly needs

nodes.label_he: הלכה -- אינה צריכה בדיקה
nodes.label_en: [if it] walked -- it does not need inspection

nodes.label_he: אחת זו ואחת זו צריכה בדיקה
nodes.label_en: Rav Chiyya bar Ashi: both this and that need inspection

nodes.label_he: פשטה ידה לעמוד, אף על פי שלא עמדה
nodes.label_en: Rav (via Rav Yirmeya bar Acha): [if] it stretched out its foreleg to stand, even though it did not…

nodes.label_he: עקרה רגלה להלך, אף על פי שלא הלכה
nodes.label_en: [if] it lifted its leg to walk, even though it did not walk [-- it counts as having walked]

nodes.label_he: ננערה לעמוד, אף על פי שלא עמדה
nodes.label_en: Rav Chisda: [if] it struggled to stand, even though it did not stand [-- it counts as having stood]

nodes.label_he: היכא דנפלה מן הגג בדלא ידעה
nodes.label_en: the ruling: where it fell from the roof unawares [-- stood and did not walk: inspection, not twenty…

nodes.label_he: נפולה שאמרו -- צריכה בדיקה כנגד בני מעיים
nodes.label_en: the fallen animal they spoke of needs inspection against the intestines

nodes.label_he: צריכה בדיקה כנגד בית החלל כולו
nodes.label_en: it needs inspection against the whole body cavity

nodes.label_he: סימנין מאי?
nodes.label_en: Huna Mar to Rav Ashi: the simanim -- what [of them]?

nodes.label_he: סימנין קשין הן אצל נפילה
nodes.label_en: Rav Ashi: the simanim are hard as against falling

nodes.label_he: עוף שנחבט על פני המים, כיון ששט מלא קומתו -- דיו
nodes.label_en: Shmuel (via Rav Yehuda): a bird that was struck on the surface of the water -- once it swam its ful…

nodes.label_he: ולא אמרן אלא ממטה למעלה
nodes.label_en: we said this only [where it swam] from below to above

nodes.label_he: אבל מלמעלה למטה -- מיא הוא דאשפלוה
nodes.label_en: but from above to below -- it is the water that carried it down

nodes.label_he: ואי מיא קיימי -- לית לן בה
nodes.label_en: and if the water is standing -- we have no concern with it

nodes.label_he: ואי שדא ציבי וקדמיה -- הא קדמיה
nodes.label_en: and if one threw chips and it overtook them -- it has overtaken them [and there is no concern]

nodes.label_he: גלימא מתיח -- חיישינן
nodes.label_en: a stretched cloak -- we are concerned

nodes.label_he: דלא מתיח -- לא חיישינן
nodes.label_en: not stretched -- we are not concerned

nodes.label_he: עוף ומעופף -- לא חיישינן
nodes.label_en: [a cloak] folded over and over -- we are not concerned

nodes.label_he: איזלא ומקרבי קיטרי -- חיישינן
nodes.label_en: a net whose knots are close -- we are concerned

nodes.label_he: לא מקרבי קיטרי -- לא חיישינן
nodes.label_en: its knots not close -- we are not concerned

nodes.label_he: כיתנא דעביד בטוני -- חיישינן
nodes.label_en: flax made into bundles -- we are concerned

nodes.label_he: דהאי גיסא ודהאי גיסא -- לא חיישינן
nodes.label_en: on this side or that side [of the bundles] -- we are not concerned

nodes.label_he: אסורייתא -- חיישינן
nodes.label_en: bundles of reeds -- we are concerned

nodes.label_he: כיתנא דדייק ונפיץ -- לא חיישינן
nodes.label_en: flax beaten and combed -- we are not concerned

nodes.label_he: דייק ולא נפיץ -- חיישינן
nodes.label_en: beaten and not combed -- we are concerned

nodes.label_he: דעביד בזרי כיון דאיכא ביה קטרי -- חיישינן
nodes.label_en: made into skeins -- since it has knots, we are concerned

nodes.label_he: דקתא -- חיישינן
nodes.label_en: [coarse] tow -- we are concerned

nodes.label_he: דקדקתא -- לא חיישינן
nodes.label_en: fine tow -- we are not concerned

nodes.label_he: נברא -- חיישינן
nodes.label_en: navra [palm fibre] -- we are concerned

nodes.label_he: תימחתא -- לא חיישינן
nodes.label_en: timachta [palm bark] -- we are not concerned

nodes.label_he: קיטמא נהילא -- חיישינן
nodes.label_en: sifted ashes -- we are concerned

nodes.label_he: לא נהילא -- לא חיישינן
nodes.label_en: unsifted -- we are not concerned

nodes.label_he: חול הדק -- לא חיישינן
nodes.label_en: fine sand -- we are not concerned

nodes.label_he: חול הגס -- חיישינן
nodes.label_en: coarse sand -- we are concerned

nodes.label_he: אבק דרכים -- חיישינן
nodes.label_en: road dust -- we are concerned

nodes.label_he: תיבנא ועביד בזגא -- חיישינן
nodes.label_en: straw made into a bundle -- we are concerned

nodes.label_he: לא עביד בזגא -- לא חיישינן
nodes.label_en: not made into a bundle -- we are not concerned

nodes.label_he: חיטי וכל דמינייהו -- חיישינן
nodes.label_en: wheat and all its kind -- we are concerned

nodes.label_he: שערי וכל דמינייהו -- חיישינן
nodes.label_en: barley and all its kind -- we are concerned

nodes.label_he: כל מיני קטניות -- אין בהם משום ריסוקי אברים
nodes.label_en: all kinds of legumes -- they carry no [concern] of shattered limbs

nodes.label_he: לבר מן רוביא
nodes.label_en: except fenugreek

nodes.label_he: חימצי -- אין בו משום ריסוק אברים
nodes.label_en: chimtzei -- no [concern] of shattered limbs

nodes.label_he: חפצי -- יש בו משום ריסוק אברים
nodes.label_en: chiftzei -- there is [concern] of shattered limbs

nodes.label_he: כללא דמלתא: כל מידי דמשריק -- אין בו משום ריסוק אברים
nodes.label_en: the rule of the matter: anything that slides away -- no [concern] of shattered limbs

nodes.label_he: לא משריק -- יש בו משום ריסוק אברים
nodes.label_en: does not slide -- there is [concern] of shattered limbs

nodes.label_he: דבוק -- רב אשי שרי
nodes.label_en: a bird [fallen while stuck] to a davuk -- Rav Ashi permits

nodes.label_he: אמימר אסר
nodes.label_en: Ameimar forbids

nodes.label_he: בחד גפא -- דכולי עלמא לא פליגי דשרי
nodes.label_en: [stuck] by one wing -- everyone agrees it is permitted

nodes.label_he: כי פליגי בתרי גפי -- [מאן דשרי]
nodes.label_en: [stuck] by two wings -- permitted [the permitter's position in the dispute]

nodes.label_he: בתרי גפי -- אסיר
nodes.label_en: [stuck] by two wings -- forbidden

nodes.label_he: כי פליגי בחד גפא -- [מאן דאסר]
nodes.label_en: [stuck] by one wing -- forbidden [the forbidder's position in the איכא דאמרי version]

nodes.label_he: מאן דאסר אמר לך: היכי ניקום?
nodes.label_en: the one who forbids would say: how will it stand itself up?

nodes.label_he: ומאן דשרי אמר לך: אפשר דניקום אעיקבי דגפי
nodes.label_en: and the one who permits would say: it can stand itself up on the tips of its wings

nodes.label_he: מאן דשרי אמר לך: אפשר דפרח בחד גפא
nodes.label_en: the one who permits would say: it can fly with one wing

nodes.label_he: ומאן דאסר: כיון דבהאי לא מצי פרח, בהאי נמי לא מצי פרח
nodes.label_en: and the one who forbids: since it cannot fly with this one, it cannot fly with that one either

nodes.label_he: מתקיף לה רבינא: ודלמא חוט השדרה איפסיק
nodes.label_en: מתקיף לה רבינא: ודלמא חוט השדרה איפסיק? -- perhaps the spinal cord is severed [and it is a tereifa]…

nodes.label_he: ואפילו הכי הלכתא כרב יימר: שגרונא שכיח, חוט השדרה לא שכיח
nodes.label_en: ואפילו הכי הלכתא כרב יימר: שגרונא שכיח, חוט השדרה לא שכיח -- even though this one was found severed…

nodes.label_he: ואפילו הכי הלכתא כרב יימר
nodes.label_en: ואפילו הכי הלכתא כרב יימר

nodes.label_en: והלכתא: היכא דנפלה מן הגג בדלא ידעה, ועמדה ולא הלכה -- ... ואינה צריכה מעת לעת

nodes.label_he: והלכתא: ... ועמדה ולא הלכה
nodes.label_en: והלכתא: ... ועמדה ולא הלכה -- צריכה בדיקה

nodes.label_he: ואם הלכה
nodes.label_en: ואם הלכה -- אפילו בדיקה נמי לא צריכה (as Rav, against Rav Chiyya bar Ashi)

nodes.label_en: והילכתא: בתרי גפי אסיר

nodes.label_en: מאי טעמא? כי שדו להו אמתנייהו שדו להו, כי היכי דלירהטו קמייהו

nodes.label_en: אמר ליה רבא לרב נחמן: תניא דמסייע לך -- a one-day infant becomes impure by ziva; ואי סלקא דעתך יש ב…

nodes.label_en: הכא במאי עסקינן, כגון שיצא דרך דופן -- here it is one born by caesarean

nodes.label_en: תא שמע: עגל שנולד ביום טוב -- שוחטין אותו ביום טוב

nodes.label_en: הכא נמי, כגון שיצא דרך דופן -- here too, born by caesarean

nodes.label_he: תא שמע: ושוין שאם נולד הוא ומומו עמו, שזה מן המוכן
nodes.label_en: תא שמע: ושוין שאם נולד הוא ומומו עמו, שזה מן המוכן

nodes.label_en: וכי תימא הכא נמי שיצא דרך דופן -- and if you say here too, born by caesarean
